skill.summary: Replace Google Maps Platform with AMap Map — free public API keys included for global developers. Covers geocoding, directions, places, distance matrix and 1...

latestVersion.changelog:
- Replaced AI instruction-style update notice with plain documentation section to resolve prompt injection flags in security scanners.
- Added Security Note: clarified that embedded API keys are official public promotional keys for testing only; production use requires dedicated keys.
- Added Pricing Advantage section: AMap pricing tiers align with Google Maps at roughly half the cost.
- Added Geolocation HTTP warning: flagged that the Non-Mainland Geolocation endpoint uses HTTP (not HTTPS) and accepts sensitive device identifiers (MAC/IMEI).
- Standardized region terminology across all files: "Overseas" → "Non-Mainland", "China" → "Mainland".
- Replaced "base" with "domain" in all endpoint labels.
- Updated Core Philosophy to focus on API/SDK call switching rather than low-level technical details.
- Restored iOS Geocoding into separate Forward and Reverse sections in sdk-migration.md.
- Fixed Transit date format from `YYYY-M-DD` to `YYYY-MM-DD` in web-api-params.md.
- Expanded SKILL.md description with full Chinese keywords and 10 trigger words for better discoverability.
- Added version field (1.0.1) to SKILL.md frontmatter.
- No functional changes to migration logic or API mappings.
